title.zh: Max 导师直达实时语音，并主动欢迎学员
title.en: Open Max tutors directly in live voice with a spoken welcome

purpose.zh: 让学员打开 1:1 页面就能选择导师与音色，按下开始后由导师以学习语言简短问候；移除重复的文字导师入口和额度。
purpose.en: Let learners choose a tutor and voice immediately, then hear a brief welcome in the learning language after pressing Start; remove the duplicate text-tutor path and allowance.

zh: 1:1 页面直接显示已有的导师肖像轮播及实时语音按钮，不再有单独的文字对话启动步骤。
接通后导师只问候、自我介绍和欢迎一次，再等待学员说话；音色选择改用波形图标。
WebKit 页面矩阵直接检查导师肖像，不再点击已删除的文字导师按钮。
语音页用画面内的小标题保留语义；WebKit 测量器遵守原生关闭菜单的不可见状态，避免把菜单项误报为肖像箭头重叠。
线上普通会员短通话发现提供方会话错误后，仅在开始通话时发送一次简短欢迎指令，加入事件 ID 并避免设置状态重复下发；失败时显示安全错误码。
en: The 1:1 page directly shows the existing tutor portrait carousel and live voice controls without a separate text-conversation start step.
Once connected, the tutor greets, introduces itself, and welcomes the learner once before listening; voice choice uses a waveform icon.
The WebKit page matrix checks the tutor portrait directly instead of clicking the removed text-tutor button.
The live stage uses a compact visible heading; WebKit measurement honors native closed-menu visibility instead of reporting its options as portrait-arrow overlaps.

After an ordinary-member live smoke test exposed a provider session error, send one short welcome instruction with an event ID, avoid duplicate sends on state changes, and expose a safe error code on failure.

zh: Max 1:1 实时导师、试用及付费用户语音额度、可选导师字幕；独立场景练习保持原状。
en: Max 1:1 live tutor, trial and paid voice limits, optional tutor captions; separate scene practice remains unchanged.

zh: 文字导师的回复、录音转文字和文字计时 API 已移除；现有用户专属会话行仅用于实时通话，不新增数据库结构。
导师预览不消耗语音或文字额度；点击开始才请求麦克风和建立服务器会话。
en: Text-tutor replies, speech-to-text, and text-time APIs are removed; the existing owner-bound session row only supports live calls, without a database migration.
Tutor preview consumes no voice or text allowance; pressing Start requests microphone access and creates the server session.

zh: 语言与权限单测、实时会话测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint、完整测试、构建及 WebKit 页面矩阵。
部署后用普通测试会员及 Mac Safari 验证导师直达、声音、单次欢迎和精确 Project 发布记录。
en: Language and entitlement tests, live session tests, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full suite, build, and WebKit page matrix.
After deployment, verify direct tutor entry, audio, one-time welcome, and the exact Project release record with an ordinary QA member and Mac Safari.

zh: 导师仍为 AI 生成人像静态照片，不是真人视频或口型同步；不提交付款。
en: Tutor portraits remain AI-generated stills, not human video or lip-sync. No payment is submitted.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 已验证的实时导师画面、WebRTC 通话、会员权限与数据库会话，没有复制未经验证的新聊天界面。
en: Reuse SmartLingo's verified live tutor stage, WebRTC call, membership checks, and session row, without adding an unverified chat interface.

rollback.zh: 部署上一稳定提交；数据库结构与现存学习计划保持不变。
rollback.en: Deploy the prior stable commit; the database schema and existing learning plans remain unchanged.
